name: Aflaj Irrigation Systems of Oman
description: In the dry interior of Oman, aflaj are gravity-fed channels that carry water from springs and underground sources to village homes and date groves. This listing covers five of roughly 3,000 still in use, some perhaps dating back to 2500 BC. Water is shared out by long-standing community rules guided by the stars, and watchtowers built to guard the supply still stand beside the channels.
